learned: 2026-10-05, by hand: 99 product pages in the Yoast product sitemap (65 vapes, 14 gummies, 11 dabs, 5 tinctures, 4 pre-rolls). NY-only brand (OCM-PROC-24-000091, Naturae LLC). jauntyvapes.com is a grey-market reseller, not the brand.
notes: Read from the product pages, not /wp-json/wp/v2/product: that post type has titles and taxonomy classes but no content, and sizes are only on the pages. The div.elementor-location-single carries the taxonomy slugs as classes (product-type-*, vape-type-*, gummy-type-*), which the category rules read.

Lines are Jaunty's own vape-type and gummy-type terms: Classic, Live Resin, Live Rosin, Palms, All-Stars, Liquid Diamonds; Hash, Fast-Acting, Live Rosin. Three old Classic carts are titled with the strain alone ('LSD', 'White Widow', 'Strawberry Cough').

Sizes the pages state are read from them: Palms 'Available In 1.5 grams', All-Stars and Liquid Diamonds '1 GRAM / 1.5 GRAM ALL-IN-ONE VAPE', gummies the THC mg (per gummy or per package) plus 'Available In 10 Pack', tinctures 'NNNmg THC per bottle'.

Cart and badder pages state no size, so those are constants checked against NY store listings on 2026-10-05: Classic and Live Resin carts 1g, Live Rosin carts 0.5g, Cold Cure badder 1g (three badder slugs also end in -1g). A new size in one of those lines would be read wrong; recheck if stores show one.

Hash Hole pre-rolls are '.8 grams of <flower> paired with .2 grams of <rosin> solventless live rosin', so 1g; the rule requires that sentence. The strain is the flower strain, the way stores name it ('Live Rosin Hash Hole Velvet Lushers'); the rosin strain is in the title.

Hash gummies Dreamberry and Orange Swirl and every Fast-Acting gummy also come in a '2 Pack trial size'. One page is one item, so only the 10-pack is an entry; the 2-packs stay as the stores' consensus.
Sold-out products stay in the sitemap (the page says SOLD OUT); they are kept, since stores sell through old stock. Merch is on merch.jaunty.com, not here.

when.body: \.8 grams? of .+ paired with \.2 grams? of .+ solventless live rosin
